Asset: WELL-0112 (NE-07 Well 112, T200, Northeast Block 7) Equipment: flowline Work started: 09 Dec 2022 08:00 · Finished: 10 Dec 2022 00:00 · Well stopped for this job: 16 hours Crew lead: Brian Coleman (U-304) · Crew: Megan Ward Triggered by: inspection INS-0112-0008 on 2022-12-08 Report written: 10 Dec 2022

What happened

The weekly manual inspection INS-0112-0008 at 11:30 on 2022-12-08 found crude oil on the pad: about 4.4% of the pad area, estimated 1.4 bbl. The inspector noted: "Dark staining on pad." The field operator shut the well in, closed the flowline valve and placed earth berms and absorbent pads. The release was contained about 4.6 hours after the inspection. The crew traced the leak to a threaded coupling on the flowline close to the wellhead.

Root cause

Thread fatigue from pump jack vibration.

Safety and permits

  • Pre-job safety meeting held with the crew before work started (WS-01).
  • Energy isolated: prime mover stopped at the bottom of the stroke, brake set and chained, motor disconnect locked and tagged, wellhead wing valve closed and tagged, pressure bled off (WS-02).

Work done

  1. Excavated around the coupling.
  2. Cut out the failed coupling and the pipe ends.
  3. Welded in new pipe and a new fitting.
  4. Coated the new joints.
  5. Excavated the stained soil.
  6. Backfilled after the pressure test.

Summary of the fix: replaced leaking flowline section and remediated soil.

Testing and return to service
